    n, D = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    subordinates = defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        p_i = int(sys.stdin.readline())
        subordinates[p_i].append(i)

    def count_ways(employee, max_salary):
        if not subordinates[employee]:
            return min(max_salary, D)
        total_ways = 1
        for subordinate in subordinates[employee]:
            total_ways = (total_ways * count_ways(subordinate, max_salary)) % MOD
        return (total_ways * min(max_salary, D)) % MOD

    print(count_ways(1, D))
